// diagnostic

E2424

Function `{function}` promises `Never` but uses a bare `return`.

What

Function `{function}` promises `Never` but uses a bare `return`.

Why

A declared `Never` return cannot complete with an empty return; every path must diverge (D-NEVER2=B).

Fix

Remove the bare `return`, or make this function return a value type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2424: tests/ui/never_return_bare.stderr.
